lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized in roughly horizontal rows and vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a geometric lattice across the trunk.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered towards the anterior base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, elongated occlusion is visible on the dorsal ridge immediately posterior to the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct transition in pattern density from small, irregularly spaced spots on the cephalic region to larger, organized clusters on the lateral flank.
